notes.title: Fix the game crash issue
notes.content: [p]The game crash issue has been fixed[/p]

notes.title: Performance optimization update
notes.content: [p]1. Add road guidance within levels.[/p][p]2. Optimize some experiences of cruise ships.[/p][p]3. Remove the collision of windmills and make them merely decorative.[/p][p]4. Enhance the road traffic system.[/p][p]5. Performance optimization of the large map, reaching 150 frames per second.[/p][p]6. The issue of freezing has been resolved. Currently, a significant number of freezing problems have been reduced. If it still occurs, we will continue to address it in the future.[/p]

notes.title: The Demo of "Rider Valkyries" has undergone a major update
notes.content: [p][b]Based on feedback from some friends, I've made the following updates. The current demo offers significantly improved gameplay—you're welcome to try it out![/b][/p][olist][*][p][b]Improved hit feedback[/b]: Added real-time sound effects to make combat more impactful and immersive.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Police are in![/b] What’s a violent motorcycle game without the cops? Be careful not to get caught by the police ladies—they’ll throw you in jail for a big communal meal! Of course... you could also [i]dominate[/i] them if you prefer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Collision logic added[/b]: Knocking girls off their bikes now heals you. Didn’t see that coming, did you? (But remember: it's just a game—don't try this in real life!)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vehicles added[/b]: They're heavy and tough. You're squishy and fast. Be careful not to get hit, or you'll go flying! Safety first—unless you like being laughed at by your friends.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera improved[/b]: Reduced motion sickness during ragdoll-style collisions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting tweaks[/b]: Fixed overexposure issues in some scenes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stuck bug fixes[/b]: Optimized terrain and object colliders to prevent getting trapped.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map collision optimization[/b]: Reduced small-object collisions for smoother driving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Victory & restart logic[/b]: Now you can officially win (and start over) the game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Control remap[/b]: Adjusted key settings to match the classic Road Rash feel.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Melee & kick animations tuned[/b]: Improved the rhythm and timing of attacks.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon pickup system added[/b]: Defeat other riders to get weapons![/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Experience Speed and Style — Rider Valkyries Demo Released
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone, nice to meet you, and thank you for your support![/b][/p][p]It’s been a month since [i]Rider Valkyries[/i] launched its store page, and we’ve been working hard to bring frequent updates and improvements.
We’re excited to announce that the [b]Demo is now officially available[/b] — feel free to try it out, add the game to your wishlist, and share it with your friends![/p][p][i]Rider Valkyries[/i] is a brand-new open-world game inspired by [i]Road Rash[/i], reimagined in a vibrant anime style.
The story unfolds in [b]Maireya[/b], a fantasy continent inspired by Miami — a wild, colorful land full of danger, charm, and high-speed action.[/p][p]With a world spanning over [b]100 square kilometers[/b], [i]Rider Valkyries[/i] features a complete blend of urban and wilderness ecosystems.
Get ready to ride powerful combat bikes, command adorable yet fierce Valkyrie riders, and wield all kinds of unique weapons in your journey through this thrilling open world.[/p][p]We have tons of exciting content in the works, and your support means the world to us.
[b]Thank you for playing [i]Rider Valkyries[/i]![/b][/p]
